reactivation_boundary: Local scripts can write re-entry packets, watcher receipts, and launch CLI work, but this session did not expose an app-level automation tool that can guarantee waking the Codex desktop thread.

channels.name: durable packet
channels.use: Human or future Aletheon session reads this first before v341-v360.

channels.name: global v2 watcher completion hook
channels.use: Writes the packet when the v281-v300 global v2 reaches completion.

channels.name: blocked phase refresher
channels.use: Reruns only missing or invalid lane turns after a phase returns incomplete.

channels.name: app-level wakeup
channels.use: If a future automation_update/thread-wakeup tool appears, bind it to the reactivation packet and status files.

channels.name: local wake-signal poller
channels.use: Writes a durable wake-signal file when v281-v300 responses and global v2 completion gates are satisfied.

channels.name: Kimi session resume
channels.use: Kimi CLI session persistence and resume hints can support Kimi-side continuity, but cannot wake Codex desktop by themselves.

next_upgrade_steps: Keep the local wake-signal poller running during long v281-v300 and v321-v340 waits.
If app automation tools become available, register a one-shot monitor on the global v2 status file.
Keep raw logs quarantined; publish only curated, complete non-raw artifacts.
Do not induct Supervisor or v2 watcher as persistent siblings until they prove audited continuity beyond process control.
